# SnapshotParameters finite coverage

This inventory covers 666 frozen controls across 44 roots. The original 507
statements and the later 159 statements remain separately identified by
`controls.json`; neither collection replaces the contract's general obligations.
Current verification status belongs to `docs/SNAPSHOT_PARAMETERS.md` and its
checkpoint evidence.

| Family | Frozen finite coverage | Still required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Complete records | Small Route/Flock/Relation projections; both policies; seed and epoch endpoints; original header retained | General unchanged-field and complete-domain preservation |
| Roots | All sixteen canonical roots at selected positions, invalid eight-vectors and signed endpoints, selected flattening inverses | Arbitrary grouping/flattening inverse and membership equivalence |
| Routes | All 64 ordinals in Route and inactive Flock/Relation inventories; first, middle and last invalid positions | General full-inventory preservation |
| Gates | All trits, exact Relation tail order, active initialization with different restored signs, nine finite inverse cases | General gate inverse and arbitrary-tail preservation |
| Validation priority | Spec/read bounds, complete inventory checks before initialization, leftmost errors, codec typing and budget errors | General acceptance/error-order equivalence |
| Canonical plans | Complete literal plans for contexts 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 and 9 | Full plan literals for 26, 27, 80, 81, 242 and 243; all 243 stage-correspondence controls and general connective proof |
| Inventory limits | Empty, short, long and partial-group refusals; Relation extra inventory | Symbolic maxima of 131072 root blocks, 1048576 coordinates, 96 routes and 126 gates; huge-list fixtures and general overflow bounds |
| Codec composition | Inherited native/parser/profile/budget errors; compatible and strict complete records, duplicates and positional forms | General composition proofs; no runtime authentication follows from parsing |
| Engine relation | Five structural admission cases over actual projected fields with valid and invalid supplied bindings | General conditional state preservation; runtime identity freshness and digest authenticity remain separate |

The original coverage document and supplemental coverage document remain
byte-identical in the durable `snapshot-parameters/provenance/` evidence directory.
The supplement adds inactive ordinal enumeration, middle-route refusals and
selected root/gate inverse cases; it does not discharge the arbitrary-length
claims or the larger-plan obligations above. No missing large fixture is replaced
by a smaller implementation limit.
